description: Land Acquisition - Welikada and Kotuwegoda, Sri Jayawardenapura,  Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District  Sec 07
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for a public purpose. It contains descriptions of individual land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category (Type 4). There is no mention of government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category that would take precedence.
